verdict.reason: GlobalConfigEffects already separates stop and post-decrement zero-reference calls with exactly the native argument shapes. The source destructor owns the real atomic decrement and slot ordering. A stateless concrete provider can perform genuine current-table calls without fixed profile selection or projected Sound conversion.
verdict.integration_limit: A correct generic provider does not make numeric original-image profile identities callable in the rebuilt process and cannot accept nonnative SoundInstance/SoundLevelEntry layouts. Current raw sample construction uses a numeric D5B074 identity and a separate source cleanup adapter. Actual admitted payload/table construction and producer lifetime remain required.
verdict.second_array_producer: Still unresolved. Non-null second-array objects must satisfy the explicit runtime raw-object/current-table/reference/lifetime contract; no empty-array or D5ABF8 assumption is used.
verdict.exception_limit: The existing GlobalConfigEffects methods and aggregate cleanup are noexcept. A provider using them preserves the current normal-flow/nonthrowing source contract; it does not establish original EH/SEH behavior when a native virtual method throws.

proposed_provider.name: NativeGlobalConfigCurrentDispatch (proposed; not implemented)
proposed_provider.stop_function_pointer_signature: using StopMethod = void (__thiscall*)(void* actual_object, std::uint32_t flag);
stop_body_contract: Read the current table pointer from the actual object at callback entry.
Read StopMethod from that table byte offset 8, equivalent to the third four-byte entry on Win32.
Call method(actual_object, flag), using actual_object as ECX and one DWORD stack argument. The aggregate currently supplies zero.
Do not retain or use the receiver after the target returns; the target may destroy/rebind the owning slot.
zero_body_contract: This callback is entered after the source release operation has already decremented actual_object+4 to zero.
Read the actual object current table now, then read ZeroMethod at byte offset 0.
Call method(actual_object), ECX=actual object with no stack arguments.
Do not decrement, retain, free directly, clear owner slots, select an old profile, or call a high-level release routine here.
proposed_provider.table_reads: Use a fresh actual-object/table read in each callback. Existing read<T> memcpy helper can read the pointer and method pointer under Win32 representation assertions. Do not cache across stop, slot reload, atomic decrement or separate callback invocations.
proposed_provider.platform: MSVC Win32; require _MSC_VER/_M_IX86 and four-byte object/function pointers. Existing atomic counter contract uses a four-byte aligned LONG at object+4.

runtime_preconditions: Each non-null slot represents a valid owned intrusive reference; actual object+4 is an accessible, aligned four-byte interlocked counter belonging to that same object.
Every first-array object provides a valid current-process method table with callable v+0 of the no-stack-argument zero-reference ABI.

Every second-array object additionally provides callable current v+8 with actual receiver in ECX and one DWORD flag. The unknown producer must establish this interface and lifetime; no particular profile or Sound type is inferred.
After stop returns, any non-null replacement in the slot must independently satisfy the same reference/table/lifetime contract. The original stopped object need not be the released object.
The actual object remains valid through the counter transition and current zero-table read; method bodies and their contexts/allocators outlive the call.
Callable table entries must be genuine addresses in the current executable/process, not original-image numeric profile labels or a C++ projection service vtable.
No exception may cross the existing noexcept source callbacks if retaining the current normal-flow contract. Native exceptional cleanup fidelity requires a separate interface/unwind scope.
what_this_closes: The missing concrete stop/zero callback bodies can be implemented using real native-style current-table calls, with no unresolved abstract callback inside those two bodies.
The existing source can keep its actual InterlockedDecrement exactly once per release and all mutation-sensitive slot ordering.
what_this_does_not_close: Discovery or construction of the second-array producer.
Admission of existing projected Sound instances as native raw objects.
Callable-table validity of current raw sample objects carrying numeric profile identities.
GlobalConfigContext shared lifetime/string bindings and outer-owner current scalar-deletion dispatch.
Original EH/SEH exception propagation and cleanup semantics.
Build, emitted ABI, live runtime or gameplay validation of the proposed provider.
